block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.too_cold: Too cold here. The Furnace Warden only wakes in the Nether.
advancements.sanupcraft.root.title: Sanupcraft
advancements.sanupcraft.root.description: Factories open boss fights, bosses open factories. Start by mining iron.
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.title: Double and More
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.descript: Raw ore crushes into 2 dust, sometimes with another metal. Crush coal into coal dust: an Alloy Smelter turns iron dust + coal dust into steel.
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.title: Parts Bin
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.descr: An Assembler turns steel plates into machine parts. Hoppers: top for input, side for fuel, bottom for output.
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.title: Rustproof
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.descriptio: A full steel set blocks the Rusty Guardian's rust. Build a Guardian Altar and a Summoning Stone.
advancements.sanupcraft.guardian_core.de: Defeat the Rusty Guardian. Its core makes a Reinforced Machine Frame, and the Crusher splits it into 4 shards.
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.title: Full Steam
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.descripti: Pipe steam into machines so they run without fuel. A Belt Motor (needs a frame) runs conveyor belts.
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.title: Assembly Line
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.descr: Automate gear parts. Heatproof gear needs many parts and core shards.
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.title: Fireproof
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.descri: A full heatproof set grants fire resistance. The Nether is waiting: get a blaze rod from a fortress.
The Furnace Warden only wakes in the heat of the Nether. Build an altar there.
advancements.sanupcraft.warden_heart.des: Defeat the Furnace Warden. Its heart builds a Heart Forge.
advancements.sanupcraft.heart_forge.desc: Ancient debris → 2 netherite scrap, blaze rod → 4 blaze powder. Craft eyes of ender and head for the End.
advancements.sanupcraft.shulker_shell.de: Shulker shells from End cities make Ender Senders and Receivers.
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.title: Across Dimensions
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.descr: Dye a sender and a receiver the same color: items cross dimensions. Nether mine → Overworld factory.
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.title: Iron Age
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.descrip: Mine raw iron. A Crusher (3 iron ingots, 2 flint, 4 cobblestone) turns it into 2 dust plus byproducts.
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.title: Not in Vanilla
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.descriptio: Steel! Make a Steel Hammer (3x3 mining), steel armor, and press it into plates for machine parts.
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.title: Nine at Once
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.descripti: Hammers and excavators dig 3x3. Sneak to dig a single block.
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.title: The Ground Digs Itself
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.descripti: A Steam Quarry mines the 9x9 below it down to the bottom. Put a chest or a belt on top and feed the crusher.
